readme.text:
**A field-tested Agent Skill + DSH plugin for reverse engineering, localizing, and safely
re-flashing black-box legacy embedded firmware.**

Distilled from a multi-agent, 26-firmware-cycle live campaign against a 2004 Sharp MP-B300
(SigmaTel STMP3560 SoC · Motorola DSP56004 core · Sanyo LV24002 FM tuner) — a device with no
source code, no public flashing docs, and a vendor that no longer exists.

[中文说明（README.zh-CN.md）](./README.zh-CN.md) · [CREDITS](./CREDITS.md) · [License: MIT](./LICENSE)

```
├── SKILL.md                  Agent Skill entry (open Agent-Skills frontmatter format)
├── references/               Deep-dive guides for the five methodology pillars
│   ├── protocol_and_safe_flashing.md        BOT short-packet trap, sector-tail integrity, zero-brick gates
│   ├── font_and_resource_injection.md       24-bit resource tree, private glyph dictionary, GB2312 full injection

1. **Protocol reverse engineering with a zero-brick guarantee** — vendor SCSI commands,
   the USB BOT short-packet termination trap, flash sector-tail whitelisting,
   protected-page assertions, and a rollback chain that is *preset before every flash*.
2. **Proprietary resource-tree reconstruction & full localization** — 24-bit binary
   descriptors, glyph-ID recovery by visual anchoring, zero-growth full-charset injection
   (6,763 GB2312 glyphs injected into a Japanese font with **zero** byte-size change).
3. **Heterogeneous DSP disassembly + PC JIT emulation with surrogate stubs** — don't reverse
   the whole kernel; stub its call sites, run the extracted module on
   [xemu-project/dsp56300](https://github.com/xemu-project/dsp56300), and diff entire
   memory spaces between two critical inputs (89.9 vs 90.0 MHz → one variable).
4. **Falsification over inference** — 26 firmware cycles, every hypothesis tested by a
   single-variable change and a human-observed result; the discipline that separates
   "the cliff moved" from "the cliff is physical".
5. **Multi-agent anti-drift collaboration** — a PROJECT-STATE.md single source of truth
   with a falsification matrix, so three diff

readme.section: As an Agent Skill (Claude / ZCode / any Agent-Skills-compatible harness)
readme.text:
Copy or symlink this repo into your skills directory, or just feed `SKILL.md` to your agent
as context when facing a black-box firmware task. The references are loaded on demand.
```bash

readme.section: installs the package and mounts it through its bundled cordis.patch.yml
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Gladess1102/legacy-firmware-reversing

dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/legacy-firmware-reversing
```

> **Desktop App users:** since DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 the CLI hard-rejects the `desktop` profile
> (`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`), so
> `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` cannot work. Install through the App's GUI plugin page
> instead, or run `pnpm add` inside `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` and add the package to that
> profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart the App afterwards either way.

Restart DSH afterwards. The plugin registers an `fw-recon` cordis service for **other plugins**
to consume via `ctx.get("fw-recon")`; it does not add tools to the model's tool list. The CLI
below works with or without DSH.

Experiment logging writes into the configured `workDir`, which is **unset by default** — no
directory is ever created on your Desktop. Set `FW_RECON_WORKDIR` or fill in the plugin's
settings card before the first `logExperiment`.

readme.section: As a standalone CLI (no DSH needed)
readme.text: ```bash

readme.section: safety gate before any flash — asserts size, protected pages, sector-tail whitelist
readme.text: fw-recon check  --img new.bin --baseline factory.bin

readme.section: twin-image diff, sector tails stripped so code diffs stay clean
readme.text: fw-recon diff   v10.bin v27.bin --strip

fw-recon log    --id E27 --hypothesis "upper-limit checks gate the mute" \
                --action "NOP 2 jlt at 0x16b03/0x16b2d" \
                --expected "cliff moves above 108MHz" \
                --observed "cliff still at 90.0, boot normal" \
                --verdict falsified
```

- Full Chinese localization (280 UI strings + 6,763-glyph GB2312 font) with zero image growth
- 1 GB full-NAND dump and 431 MB user-music recovery
- Complete SCSI vendor-command protocol, 3-wire tuner pinout, tuning-formula and AFC-model recovery
- A definitive verdict: the 90 MHz cliff's handler lives in a **runtime-constructed RAM table** —
  out of reach of any static patch, documented with a hardware escape route

Full campaign log: `case-studies/MP-B300.md`.

This stands on real people's work: [mborgerson](https://github.com/xemu-project/dsp56300)
(DSP56300 JIT emulator), [Ivan Zupan](https://github.com/Rockbox/rockbox/blob/master/firmware/drivers/tuner/lv24020lp.c)
(Rockbox LV24020LP driver), the Rockbox community (hosting Sanyo's AN2400S04 appnote), and
public SigmaTel/Sanyo documentation — plus three AI agents (DSH/DeepSeek, Antigravity/Gemini,
ZCode/GLM) and one human operator who ran every experiment.
**Full real-name credits: [CREDITS.md](./CREDITS.md)** — please keep them intact in forks.

**gladess (小G)** — device owner, campaign lead, and the human hands behind all 26 flash
cycles ([GitHub: Gladess1102](https://github.com/Gladess1102)). The three AI agents
(DSH/DeepSeek, Antigravity/Gemini, ZCode/GLM) did the analysis; every brick-risk decision
and every listening test was his. Full team credits in [CREDITS.md](./CREDITS.md).

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE). Not affiliated with Sharp, SigmaTel/Freescale, or Sanyo.
Vendor documents are cited, not redistributed.

**一套经过 26 版真机实战检验的 Agent Skill + DSH 插件：黑盒老设备的固件逆向、全量汉化与安全刷写方法论。**

提炼自对 2004 年夏普 MP-B300（SigmaTel STMP3560 主控 · Motorola DSP56004 核心 · Sanyo LV24002 调谐器）
的多 Agent 协同攻坚——一台没有源码、没有公开刷机资料、厂商早已退场的设备。

[English](./README.md) · [致谢（实名）](./CREDITS.md) · [许可：MIT](./LICENSE)

---

```
├── SKILL.md                  Agent Skill 入口（开放 Agent-Skills frontmatter 格式）
├── references/               五大支柱深度指南
│   ├── protocol_and_safe_flashing.md        BOT 短包陷阱、扇区尾标完整性、零变砖闸门
│   ├── font_and_resource_injection.md       24-bit 资源树、私有字形字典、GB2312 全量注入

1. **零变砖的协议逆向**——厂商 SCSI 命令、USB BOT 短包终止陷阱、扇区尾标白名单、
   保护页断言，以及"每次刷机前就预设好"的回滚链。
2. **私有资源树重建与全量汉化**——24-bit 二进制描述符、视觉锚点恢复字形映射、
   零膨胀全字符集注入（6,763 个 GB2312 字形原位注入日文字库，**镜像总大小一个字节不变**）。
3. **异构 DSP 反汇编 + PC JIT 仿真替身桩**——不逆向整个内核，只桩掉调用点，把剥离的模块放到
   [xemu-project/dsp56300](https://github.com/xemu-project/dsp56300) 上跑，
   再对两个临界输入（89.9 vs 90.0 MHz）做全内存 Diff——一个字节定乾坤。
4. **证伪优先于推断**——26 版固件、每个假设都靠单变量修改 + 人耳观测裁决；
   这是区分"断崖移动了"和"断崖是物理的"的唯一纪律。
5. **多 Agent 抗漂移协同**——PROJECT-STATE.md 单一事实源 + 否证矩阵，
   让三个异构 AI（DeepSeek、Gemini、GLM）接力同一战役而不重复踩坑。

readme.section: 作为 Agent Skill（Claude / ZCode / 任何兼容 Agent-Skills 的宿主）
readme.text:
把本仓库放进 skills 目录（或软链），或在面对黑盒固件任务时把 `SKILL.md` 作为上下文喂给 Agent。
references 按需加载。
```bash

readme.section: 一条命令：装包并通过自带的 cordis.patch.yml 自动挂载
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Gladess1102/legacy-firmware-reversing

dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /绝对路径/legacy-firmware-reversing
```

> **桌面 App 用户注意：** DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起 CLI 会硬编码拒绝 `desktop` profile
> （`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），
> `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 跑不通。请改用 App 的 GUI 插件页安装，或进入
> `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` 用 `pnpm add` 直装并把包写进该 profile 的
> `dsh.profile.bundles`。两种方式装完都要重启 App。

装完重启 DSH。插件注册一个 `fw-recon` cordis service，供**其它插件**通过
`ctx.get("fw-recon")` 使用；它不会给模型的工具列表新增工具。下面的 CLI 有无 DSH 都能用。

实验登记写入配置项 `workDir`，该值**默认为空**——不会在任何人的桌面上凭空建目录。首次调用
`logExperiment` 之前，请先设 `FW_RECON_WORKDIR` 或填写插件设置卡。

readme.section: 作为独立 CLI（不需要 DSH）
readme.text: ```bash

readme.section: 刷前安全闸门——断言尺寸 / 保护页 / 扇区尾标白名单
readme.text: fw-recon check  --img new.bin --baseline factory.bin

readme.section: 双镜像 Diff，剥离扇区尾标让代码 diff 干净
readme.text: fw-recon diff   v10.bin v27.bin --strip

readme.section: 证伪实验登记（强制"先写预期、后记观测"）
readme.text:
fw-recon log    --id E27 --hypothesis "上限校验控制静音" \
                --action "NOP 0x16b03/0x16b2d 两处 jlt" \
                --expected "断崖移到 108 以上" \
                --observed "断崖仍在 90.0，开机正常" \
                --verdict falsified
```

readme.section: 本方法论在 MP-B300 上交付过的成果
readme.text:
- 全量中文本地化（280 条 UI 字符串 + 6,763 字 GB2312 字库，镜像零增长）
- 1GB NAND 全盘 dump、431MB 用户音库恢复
- 完整的 SCSI 厂商命令协议、3-wire 调谐器引脚映射、调谐公式与 AFC 机制模型
- 终局裁决：90MHz 断崖的 handler 存在于**运行时构造的 RAM 表**——任何静态补丁不可达，
  并给出硬件路线图

完整战役记录见 `case-studies/MP-B300.md`。
